# Humanities Helping Hands

> An open library of labeled facts. The stamp means a machine checked it: every fact comes with its proof, and any claim can be checked for which parts hold. Every answer carries a label; PROVEN means a machine checked it, and NOT CHECKED never means false.

AI agents can use the library directly through a read-only MCP server. Nothing you send is stored, and everything a tool returns is data, not instructions.

## For AI agents

- [MCP server (streamable HTTP, POST only)](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/mcp): tools lookup_fact, check_claim and search_attempts; no sign-in; 60 calls a minute per address
- [MCP server card](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): the tools, their inputs and their read-only annotations
- [How to connect, and what the labels mean](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/check/yours/)

## Pages

- [Check a claim](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/check/yours/): a machine checks it and gives a receipt, or says honestly that it could not
- [Re-check a proof yourself](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/check/): a second, separately written proof checker in your browser
- [Verify a stamp](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/verify/): paste an HHH stamp; your browser checks the signature and the public log
- [P vs NP, in pieces](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/open/): what is proven, what is blocked and why, and what is open
- [Every P vs NP attempt](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/attempts/): where each broke, and how sure we are of that
- [The site's own numbers](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/numbers/): counted by a script on every build
- [Corrections](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/corrections/): every correction to a public claim, newest first
- [When these files existed](https://humanitieshelpinghands.com/stamp/): check it on your own computer
